name: Vampire Survivors
what: Survive huge waves of monsters while your weapons fire on their own.
lovedFeatures: Move with keys or a thumb stick; weapons attack by themselves
Waves of monsters that grow bigger
Pick 1 of 3 upgrades when you level up
extraFeatures: Weapons that combine into stronger ones
scopeNote: A great first game! One map, one hero and three weapons is plenty to start.
